ios.desc:
SUMRY helps you turn your Apple HealthKit data into clear, meaningful overviews.
Whether you’re training, traveling, or simply curious about your daily activity – SUMRY shows you where you’ve been and what you’ve achieved.

Create Summaries to explore your data in ways Apple’s Health app doesn’t:
• Totals at a glance: calories, steps, and distance across workouts or custom time ranges
• Activity ring insights: more detail than Apple’s standard views
• Maps of your routes: see all your workouts combined – runs, bike rides, hikes, city strolls and more

SUMRY is more than a fitness tracker – it’s a way to relive experiences. Look back on your vacation walks, discover which parts of a city you explored, or compare how much you ran this year versus last.

SUMRY+ UNLOCKS MORE
• Auto-Update Summaries in the background
• Home and Lockscreen widgets
• Filter workout types when creating Summaries
• Focus on workout-only health data (steps, distance)
• Organize with folders
• Compare two Summaries directly
• Extra details like daily averages & extended activity ring breakdowns

SUMRY is free to use with no limit on the number of Summaries. If you’d like more control and insights, SUMRY+ is available – and by upgrading, you also support further development by a solo indie developer.

ABOUT SUMRY & HEALTHKIT
SUMRY integrates with Apple’s Health app to read and summarize your HealthKit data. The app never writes data, never shares it, and all processing happens locally on your device. Your health data stays 100% private.
